title: Invisible blocks

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
The one you can is an invisible piston block (ID 36)
The one you can't is a barrier block and is 1.8 exclusive.

replies.author: Subscriptor
replies.body: What para said is true, however I'm pretty sure about the barrier it won't be invisible when you get close to it, it will turn into a symbol of no entrance. What I would recommend is a trick in world edit, used by some builders, when you set certain not full blocks for example chest, into a ladder and the ladder looks invisible from the other side of it, but only from one side and that's the problem. Depends on what you are trying to do.
